labelings.title: Annotation tasks
labelings.description: On this page you can see statistics and respond to annotation tasks you are part of.
labelings.tooltip:
Track all annotation tasks you can respond to:
- See overall progress and pending data records.
- Use filters to quickly find what needs to be done.
- Enter data records to submit annotations safely and consistently.
labelings.onlyAdminsNote: You can view and respond to annotation tasks you participate in, but only administrators can create new ones.

labelingsManage.title: Manage Annotation Tasks
labelingsManage.description: Manage and view annotation tasks. Click 'New Annotation Task' to import a CSV and start configuration.
labelingsManage.tooltip:
Create annotation tasks with the following flow:

1. Import CSV for column mapping.
2. Give the annotation task a title, link it to an initial annotation project, set start and end dates, and how many annotations per record are required before finalizing.
3. Manage your new annotation task by:
   • Creating a form using mapped columns as data fields, with question fields related to each data field and organized form sections.
   • Assigning annotators to respond to the annotation task.
   • Inspecting annotations in the answers dashboard.
   • Exporting a CSV with annotations from all annotators for each mapped row.
